new_campaign_pr.body:
The stabilization program and its execution evidence existed only in local uncommitted files. This publishes the canonical E0–E7 coordination cards on existing program identities, the frozen 442-PR census, additive ownership/relationship decisions, exact source-custody recovery, and the first corrective shared-ledger execution checkpoint.

The latest global sweep observed 441 open PRs and one native merge. Five open sources changed head/base, plus the merged source. Original observations and snapshots remain intact; the current execution overlay records Clio #5 red/green commits, two native finding settlements and successful hosted CI at 38c0b8c9e45160ae4fecd7d87bf6c700f62cc631. Its directory-ABA finding and independent review gate remain open.

E0 remains in breakdown, E1–E7 remain incoming, and M0–M7 remain unqualified. CMS/Cephalon agents remain paused. All 23 root gitlinks and independently owned child checkouts are unchanged. Private repository inventory stays in Git-excluded local evidence. The compressed public native corpus is retained as immutable data; scoped CSV attributes preserve its original CRLF register bytes.

Validation: root project contract (25 sources / 23 submodules / 39 invariants), workspace and project suites (36 tests / 286 assertions), zero-warning root lint, Rheos no drift, source/snapshot digests, exact staged bytes and whitespace checks. Clio separately passes BB, JVM, NBB and compiled Shadow suites plus exact-head hosted CI. Hosted checks and independent review of this PR remain required.

Entry point: docs/stabilization/tracker.md. Detailed source/action proof: docs/stabilization/e0-execution.md.
